BiblicalUsage: Nechum is named once, among those who came up with Zerubbabel from the captivity to Jerusalem. He comes up from the captivity with Zerubbabel to rebuild Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that coming home is written name by name: Nechum is counted among those who returned, and no returning exile is too small for the record.
